Py径 static distribution — third-party notices

editor.txt lists the JavaScript packages actually included in this build,
with their published copyright and license text.

The runtime directory contains the Pyodide 0.27.7 core distribution from the
pyodide npm package. It runs CPython 3.12.7. No additional Pyodide wheels are
included. The runtime version metadata is in runtime/pyodide-lock.json.

License: Pyodide-0.27.7.txt
Corresponding source: https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/tree/0.27.7
Source archive: https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/archive/refs/tags/0.27.7.tar.gz

License and copyright: CPython-3.12.7.txt
Upstream acknowledgments for incorporated software: CPython-3.12.7-bundled-notices.txt
Expat copyright text from that source release: Expat-CPython-3.12.7.txt
Source: https://github.com/python/cpython/tree/v3.12.7
Pyodide build and patches: https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/tree/0.27.7/cpython
